content.rendered:
Download FTS 21 Mod PES 2021 Apk Obb Data for Android, comes with best graphics update, players transfers, fixed manager mode rating etc.

FTS 21 Mod PES 21 for Android, looks like First Touch Soccer game for Android phones and has PES logos and emblems for the current year or season.  

FTS Mod PES works fully offline and you have the ability to manage your team in manager mode of the game, play and win divisional matches, then lift the trophy. 

Daily match challenges is also available in the FTS Mod PES 2021, whereby the system randomly pick up a soccer match for you to play everyday.

Gameplay buttons also have PES logo and work smoothly without hanging when using it to control players during a match.

Ability to manage your team is now easy, because the player development feature now shows correct player ratings, which helps you to know which player is performing better.

Commentary during gameplay sounds clearly for you to hear how you favourite team player is been called, you can also how the commentator react or commends a player for performing well in the pitch.

Football pitch in FTS Mod PES 21 is looking real just like the way you see a football pitch in real life, ball can easily been seen.

The stadium now have full crowd to cheer up your players during game play, which can be heard in the background when playing, is just like simulating Real life football.

Your favourite club season 2021 kits have been added, football clubs like Barcelona, Manchester United, Juventus players can be seen wearing the new seasonal kits.

Are you saying the FTS Mod PES in-game text is not in your language!! However you can switch the in-game language to Espanol, Italian, French, Portuguese etc.

How To Install FTS Mod PES 2021 Apk Obb Data On Android Phones.

In order to install FTS Mod PES 21 Apk Obb Data, you will need to carefully follow the steps below.

Steps To Install FTS Mod PES 2021 Apk Obb Data are:

  1. Download >> Zarchiver Pro Apk App.
  2. Open Zarchiver app and Locate FTS Mod PES 21 rar or zip file you downloaded above.
